overview: T-Hub Foundation Incubation is a state-level initiative in Telangana that supports startups through incubation, mentorship, funding access, and ecosystem enablement. It operates as India’s largest startup hub, providing infrastructure, programs, and partnerships to help founders scale from ideation to global markets. T-Hub collaborates with government, corporates, academia, and investors to foster innovation and entrepreneurship.
objectives: Empower founders with access, resources, and allies to build world-class startups from India for the World
Support founders from ideation to scale through programs, partnerships, and global access
Anchor the AIC T-Hub Foundation, India’s leading Atal Incubation Centre within a national network of 70+ AICs
Host India’s largest incubator for the defence open-innovation platform iDEX
Host MATH, India’s leading Centre of Excellence for AI and ML supported by the Department of Science and Technology
Host India’s first Google for Startups Hub
Provide access to world-class infrastructure spanning over 572,000 square feet
Strengthen founders to build and scale startups from Telangana for India and the world
eligibility: Startup must be a legally incorporated entity developing and commercializing technology-based products, platforms, or IP-led services that drive innovation, scalability, and impact. Recognised as a DPIIT-registered startup or eligible for such recognition. Core offering must be technology-based (software, hardware, deep-tech, or IP-led platform). Not a pure service-based entity (e.g., consulting, outsourcing, staffing, training, or agency-type business). Must demonstrate proof of traction in at least one of the following forms: MVP or functional prototype, paying customers or revenue, external funding (angel, VC, or grant), active pilots with institutions, corporates, or Government. Incorporated ≤ 10 years from the date of registration.
benefits: Access to 290+ mentors, 80+ value partners, 200+ MNCs and corporates, 20+ academic partners, 46+ international partners, 100+ investors, angels, and HNIs. Community access to 50+ state and Govt of India institutions. Access to T-Hub Value Providers Desk, all T-Hub events and conferences, T-Hub and Atal Innovation Mission network, tech and research facilities from global universities and partners. Information regarding govt grants, funds, and incentives. Network with investment networks, HNIs, and banks. Sector-specific programs in semiconductor, space-tech, healthcare, mobility, sustainability, AI/ML, and more. Access to co-working spaces, legal, financial, IPR, procurement, and HR support via T-Edge. Mentorship, investor networking, market access, and global partnership opportunities.
financial_support: T-Hub facilitates access to central government schemes like SISFS, SIDBI IDEX, and state government schemes like T-Spark and T-Fund. T-Fund, a joint initiative by T-Hub and the Telangana Government, provides ₹25 lakhs to ₹1 crore in funding for early-stage tech startups. Startup India Seed Fund (SISF) supports young tech startups in their first two years with funding for PoC, prototyping, and early market entry. T-Hub also manages the SIDBI IDEX Fund and facilitates funding access through its extensive VC and Angel network. Programs like AIC T-Hub Semiconductor, SpaceTech, Healthcare, and Mobility charge a program fee of INR 50,000 + GST but do not take equity in startups.
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant program (e.g., Foundation, AIC Semiconductor, SpaceTech, Healthcare, Mobility, etc.) based on startup stage and sector. 2. Visit the specific program page on T-Hub website (e.g., https://t-hub.co/aic-semiconductors). 3. Check eligibility criteria and program schedule. 4. Submit application via the provided form or contact email (e.g., aic@t-hub.co). 5. Await selection communication from T-Hub team. 6. Upon selection, complete onboarding and pay applicable program fee (if any). 7. Begin participation in the program with access to mentorship, resources, and ecosystem benefits.
required_documents: Proof of traction (MVP, prototype, revenue, funding, or pilot details)
deadlines: Rolling basis — varies by program (e.g., AIC Semiconductor: applications closure in Jan 2024; Healthcare: applications closure 28th Feb 2026; Mobility: last date of application 7th June 2025)
